macros.name: chronosbaselineskip
macros.doc: The chronos environment sets this macro equal to the current \baselineskip.

macros.name: chronoscopyleft
macros.doc: \chronoscopyleft always creates a copyleft notice, regardless of any global settings, unless copyleft is explicitly set false when invoked.

macros.name: chronosset
macros.doc: \chronosset changes the default values of globalised options, whereas the ⟨chronos preamble⟩ does not.
